inputs.description: Tidy cohort-level TSV, one row per sample, that a user assembles by concatenating multiple single-sample tmb_calculator (or mutational_signatures) runs. Verified against tmb_calculator's real scripts/run.py: its single-sample tmb_result.json carries exactly tmb_mutations_per_mb, n_total_variants, n_nonsynonymous, genome_size_mb, and classification -- a total nonsynonymous count only, with NO per-consequence-type (missense/nonsense/silent/indel) breakdown anywhere in that output; mutational_signatures' real analysis.py likewise emits only a per-sample dominant_signature label plus SBS96-context activities, not a consequence-type count breakdown. This plugin therefore requires only a primary burden/count column (aliases: tmb, tmb_mutations_per_mb, value, burden, burden_value, mutation_count, n_mutations, mutation_burden) and a sample id column (aliases: sample, sample_id, sample_name; falls back to the first column). A per-consequence-type stacked breakdown is an OPTIONAL bonus: any extra numeric column whose name ends in '_count' (e.g. missense_count, nonsense_count) is picked up generically and stacked, and an optional group column (group, cohort, cancer_type, tumor_type) drives color. sample_column / value_column / group_column / breakdown_columns can all be overridden via params.
inputs.label: Cohort Table

outputs.description: Input rows sorted high-to-low by the burden value, with a 'rank' column (1 = highest burden, ties share the minimum rank) and a 'percentile' column (pandas ascending percentile rank of the burden value: the percent of the cohort at or below this sample's value), plus a 'has_breakdown' flag when breakdown columns are present. From scripts/run.py's 'ranked_cohort.tsv' output.
outputs.label: Ranked Cohort

outputs.description: Ranked bar chart (one bar per sample, descending). Bars are stacked by any detected per-consequence-type '_count' columns when present (rows lacking breakdown data fall back to a single neutral-colored value-height bar), or plain single-color / group-colored bars otherwise. Includes an optional log-scale y-axis (default on, auto-disabled with a note when the burden column has non-positive values), a dashed median or mean reference line, and -- when both stacking and a group column are in play -- a colored group strip beneath the bars. From scripts/run.py's 'waterfall_plot.png' output.
outputs.label: Waterfall Plot

plugin.description: Cohort-level ranked mutation-burden waterfall bar chart from a tidy one-row-per-sample table: samples ranked high-to-low by a TMB / mutation-count value, with an optional per-consequence-type stacked breakdown, a log-scale y-axis option, a median/mean reference line, and optional group (cancer-type / cohort) coloring. Gives tmb_calculator (which only emits single-sample JSON) the cohort view it lacks.
plugin.name: Mutation Waterfall / TMB Ranking Plot
